content: Milando yakabhonehitwe na kuhwimulilwa Paulo
Nungunoghwa kuliloka, hata payibhele yingundangatila ng'obhe kyohele! Peni ndalongela yakya kimonehitwe na kuhwimulwa milando yakambeghite Bambo.
Nungummanya mundu yumu ywakannyubhalilite Kilisto ywene ngungwa kumi na nncheche yiipitite kakitolwa mbaka kunani muno. Nungumanya ng'obhe handa kakibhegha mummili ebu munhuki, Chapanga kangumanya.
Nungubhuyila, nungummanya mundu aywo, peni nungumanya ng'obhe kukita kakibhegha mu mmili ghwake ebu mu nhuki, Chapanga kangumanya,
Kakinyahulwa mbaka ku Paladiso. Akwao kakiyihwa milando yangakambukwa, milando yene mundu kangunoghwa ng'obhe kughalubhulila.
Handa kulitika ndalitika kwakya mundu handa aywo, peni ndalitika ng'obhe numwene, ngati ndalitikila uyoyoho ghwangu.

Handa nangapalite kulitika, ningabheghite mmughabhugha ng'obhe, kiyaha ndabhegha nungulongela hoto. Peni nungulikanikiha, ngati mundu ywohele kakotoke kumona kukita ghwa maha kyanalumu, kupitingana mumonekana mu ghala ghanughatenda na kulongela.
Ili kunganikiha ngotoke kuliloka kubhukana na uhwimulo aghu nkulu, nikipeghwa mabhino makalipa handa gha nhomi mummili, mabhino agho ndo gha nnjumbe ywa Nchipila ngati ghambamande.
Kwakya mabhino agho nikinnyupa Bambo pandatu, ngati kamuhile mabhino agho.

Peni kaking'ombela, “Umaha ghwangu ghungukukwila, kiyaha makakala ghangu ghangutwihilika kyanalumu muuyoyoho.” Kya habhu ndaliloka kwa uyelelo kulinga uyoyoho ghwangu, ngati makakala gha Kilisto ghabheghe papamu na nenga.
Kya habhu, nunguyelelwa kubhegha na mayoyoho ghangu, mukulighwa, mumapungwo, na muhimbamanda hinonopo kwakya Kilisto. Kiyaha pala pamegha na uyoyoho ndo nungubhegha ngilii.
Paulo ndo Ndumila ywa hoto ywa Chapanga
Megha handa mmughabhugha, peni mwenga mungundenda meghe habhu, mwenga ndo yikiangogha kundika, kiyaha payibhele nenga chepa kilibhi kwa ywohele, peni nenga nungulepelwa ng'obhe “Andumila akulu.”
Pameghite kwa mwenga nikilibhoneha kukita nenga ndo nndumila ywa Chapanga, nikilimbilila muno mumihabho na makangahyo na nikitenda naho.
Kahone nnando ghwohele ghunepelitwe kughutenda mumangwemuko ghangi, pangi kiyaha nikibhegha ng'obhe nhigho kwa mwenga? Handa alyo ndo uhokelo, hinu nunguayupa munekekehe.

Hinu, megha kala kuhika kwa mwenga paundatu, na ndabhayeghemela ng'obhe. Kiyaha nungupala ng'obhe hilibhi hyenu manjubha ghoha, ngati nungubhapala mwenga. Kiyaha bhana bhangubhika ng'obhe hilibhi kwakya abhele bhabhe, ngati abhele bhangunoghwa kubhika hilibhi kwakya bhana bhabhe.
Nenga megha kala kutumila kila kimeghite nakyo, mbaka kubhuha hilibhi hyangu kwakya mwenga. Payibhele yingubhoneka nenga panjweha kuapala, mwenga mungupunguha kumbala.
Basi, payibhele nikiaghaha ng'obhe kwa kupala hilibhi kwa mwenga, peni mundu yungi kaahwacha kukita nenga nu nchenjela, nuanyegheleha kwa ukubhuhi.
Bhuli, nenga nikitumila ukubhuhi ngati ndole kilibhi kyohele kwa mwenga kupitila bhandu bhanualaghilite?
Nenga nikinnyupa Titusi papamu na nnongo ywetu yungi bhahike kwa mwenga. Bhuli, Mungubhona ng'obhe kukita nenga na ywombe ndo kilibhi kimu mu lihengo? Hata mandendelo gha nenga na ywombe ndo ghamu.
Pangi mungumanya kukita mbaka hinu tungulikingikiha kwa mwenga! Peni tungulongela mihalo ayi muulongolo ghwa Chapanga, patulungana na Kilisto. Mihalo ayi yoha ndo kwakya kuachenga mwenga.

Hinu nunguyoghopa papambala kuhika kwa mwenga ndaabhona mungutama handa pammpala mabhene kyahabhu ndaayelelwa ng'obhe. Nnando aghu ghwandenda nenga ndende nnando ghwakuupala mwenga na ndahotola kubhabhona mungubhegha na mangolombano na malili na mukukalalilana na mungupingikana na mungulihwangila na mungubukutana na nungulikweha na kutendelana bhulwa.

Nunguyoghopa pangi panubhahikila kangi, Chapanga ghwangu katandenda nyuyuke muulongolo ghwenu, na nenga ndaalila muno kwakya atangalo bhaatenda ulemwa, peni bhakilipetula ng'obhe na bhangughendelela na tama hyabhe hakataho na ungongola na utyahe ghwaaghutendite.
